stations.title: Ailsa
stations.say: Thanks. I'll ask about the rest.

captions: At the base, Ailsa asks how many hours the team spent on the hill this week.
Today one entry with two written as a word stops the whole total with a traceback.
You catch the one error you expect, and let every other error through.
Now the hours that can be read are added up, and the others are listed to ask about.
Ailsa has the week's total, and the scrawled entries no longer cost her the report.
